capabilities: Schedule notes tagged #review using SM-2 intervals (1 day, 6 days, then interval times ease factor)
Add questions by hand or generate three with ChatGPT, editing and accepting or rejecting each
Grade reviews as Again, Hard, Good, or Easy with the note blurred until graded
Check a note with ChatGPT for factual errors and apply only the accepted corrections
Support Markdown, inline LaTeX, and display LaTeX in questions and reference answers
extras: The manifest carries the warning that this plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. An OpenAI API key is needed only for question generation and note checking; manual review works without one. Questions are stored in plugin data, not in the notes.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in spaced repetition, so users must schedule and test themselves on notes manually.

relations.evidence: Questions are written by hand or generated with ChatGPT, and stay in plugin data.

summary: Spaced repetition plugin that schedules notes tagged #review with SM-2 and reviews each note through hand-written or ChatGPT-generated questions.
